criterion: Provide executable golden compute model evidence for vector add, GEMM, convolution, image filter, and memory copy, with FP16/FP32 and shader-unit scaling notes where applicable.
evidence_summary: Golden compute model runs vector_add, gemm_proxy, convolution_proxy, and memory_copy; runtime demo covers image_filter; FP32 evidence passes, FP16 proxy arithmetic executes for vector_add and gemm_proxy, convolution keeps FP16 metadata, and shader-unit scaling tiers are recorded.

criterion: Provide command processor, DMA, scheduler, register map, and memory model skeleton evidence that can be smoke-run or compiled in the Ventus/Celviz proxy environment.
evidence_summary: Runnable control-plane proxy passes for command queue, DMA copy/fill, fence signal/wait, reset, FP32/FP16 kernel dispatch, completion/error interrupts, MMU fault, APB counters, and AXI byte/beat counters.

criterion: Provide repeatable tests for FP16, FP32, command submission, interrupts, AXI traffic, and throughput scaling by configured tier.
evidence_summary: Verification harness passes and checks compute model, runtime CLI, control-plane simulator, FP16 proxy outputs, runtime queue phases, interrupt/error/reset tokens, AXI/APB transaction counters, and throughput monotonicity cues.

criterion: Provide an OpenCL-like CLI demo for kernel selection, buffer binding, command submission, completion, result readback, and output inspection.
evidence_summary: OpenCL-like runtime CLI demo passes for vector_add, gemm_proxy, image_filter, and memory_copy; it lists proxy devices/tiers, validates queues and buffer bindings, records submit/wait/readback phases, completion status, per-kernel metrics, and output hashes.

criterion: Record proxy-level bandwidth, latency, power, reset, interrupt, AXI/APB, clock, and memory-map integration evidence without claiming silicon signoff.
evidence_summary: Proxy-level S5 evidence passes: control-plane metrics record APB reads/writes, AXI reads/writes, reset, completion/error interrupts, MMU fault, and fences; perf model records bandwidth, latency, tier scaling, and power-index estimates; all claims remain clean-room proxy-only, not RTL/silicon signoff.

criterion: Do not claim proprietary VeriSilicon/Vivante RTL, firmware, SDK, compiler, driver, conformance, certification, or silicon signoff from clean-room proxy artifacts.
evidence_summary: Non-goals and blocked-collateral rules are documented; active evidence is framed as clean-room proxy work, not proprietary Vivante/VeriSilicon equivalence or official conformance.

evidence_summary: Boundary evidence states that historical graphics-only material is reference-only and cannot satisfy active Rank 1 GPGPU acceptance.
